texts.at-0001: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using the established codes: "invalid_state" for wrong invoice status, "invalid_quantity" for bad quantities, "negative_amount" for negative money. Match the message style
texts.at-0002: Normalize money with round_money before validating Always pass incoming monetary values through ledgerly.money.round_money (and compare against ZERO) before storing them on models; never store raw floats or unrounded Decimals. round_money also raises BillingError("float_amount") for NaN/invalid inpu
texts.at-0003: Reject bools when validating integer fields When validating an int parameter, exclude bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) before the isinstance(x, int) check, since True/False are ints in Python and would otherwise pass quantity validation.
texts.at-0004: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
